metadata.name: uexplorer-bib
metadata.description: Add, update ("Just Accepted" to formally published), or audit BibTeX citation entries in uExplorer.bib for academic papers involving the UIH uEXPLORER total-body PET/CT scanner. Use whenever the user provides paper links/DOIs/PMIDs to add, asks to check or update "Just Accepted" entries, or wants to lint/clean uExplorer.bib and its controlled institution/keyword lists.
